title: Online Softmax Attention (FlashAttention)
signature: def flash_attention(Q, K, V, block_size, causal=False) -> tuple
hints: Keep three things per query row: the running max m, the running sum l of exp(s - m), and an unnormalized output acc = sum exp(s - m) v.
When a new block raises the max from m to m_new, every term you have summed so far is too big by exp(m - m_new). Multiply both l and acc by that factor.
Divide acc by l once, after the last block. Record m and l after every block, not just at the end.
With causal=True the mask uses global positions: key j0 + c is visible to query i when j0 + c <= i. A block can be fully masked for a row; its contribution is then zero and m does not change.
